messages:
olivia: Heads-up — since the VPC egress default-deny landed this morning + the new IAM condition on the keystore grants, our warm-pool GPU nodes in us-west-2 are failing KMS decrypts and not joining. ~40% join rate drop observed. Logs show decrypt errors.

olivia: Logs (snippet):
```
ERROR keystore.decrypt us-west-2 node=node-kw-12 status=403 "AccessDenied: KMS decrypt failed" grant_id=gr-12345 via_service_condition=false
WARN warmpool.join node=node-kw-12 reason="keystore timeout"
```

raj: ugh. that matches the rollout notes for the IAM condition — we expected some fallout but not join-wide. any quick rollback option? @olivia

maria: putting cost note: if we patch with NAT egress allowlists for keystore proxies it'll add NAT GW traffic + audit shipper overhead. rough estimate: $1800-$2600/day across the region while warmup recovers. not ideal but viable short term.

liam: two paths: 1) temporary regional allowlist for keystore endpoints from warm-pool subnets (low infra change, quick), 2) revert IAM condition on keystore grants (safer long-term but needs approval). prefer (1) as fast mitigation.

ben: the IAM condition we added was `StringEquals: { "kms:ViaService": "keystore.amazonaws.com" }` — appears to be evaluated false for our ephemeral grant flow because the grant is proxied by privatelink. so traffic isn't matching via-service. reverting that condition fixes decrypts instantly.

olivia: can we do (1) now and then roll a targeted revert of the condition? ops wants minimal blast radius.

raj: mitigation steps I can run now: add SG egress rule to allow outbound to keystore-privatelink ENIs and add VPC endpoint allowlist in firewall. sample ipset command: `ipset add keystore-privatelink 10.2.5.0/26` and fw rule `allow from warmpool-subnets -> ipset:keystore-privatelink port 443`.

liam: @raj can you open the fw exception but tag it TTL=2h and track with an audit label? we need to avoid permanent holes.

raj: will do. creating change request in infra-cs now. changelist: FW-CR 5912 TTL=120m. will also add HLB route to fallback keystore proxy in eu for any remaining fails.

sophie: question — if we allowlist, audit logs will show increased keystore traffic from warm nodes. is that acceptable for compliance? @maria

maria: short answer yes if we annotate with SOC-approved temporary exception ticket and retain logs for +30d. I flagged the cost above. also want an attestation note in the ticket.

olivia: ops-bot opened INC-8382 for the join drop and attached logs. @ops-bot can you add the FW-CR reference and cost estimate?

ops-bot: INC-8382 created. Linked FW-CR 5912 and tagged `keystore-temp-allowlist`. Estimated cost impact $2.1k/day. Reminder: escalate to security@redwood if TTL > 4h.

ben: if we're reverting the IAM condition we need 2 approvers (sec + platform). I can draft the PR that removes the `kms:ViaService` constraint and scope it to warm-pool grant ARNs only. that reduces blast radius.

liam: timeline proposal: (a) raj opens and applies allowlist (0-30m), (b) verify warm-pool join recovery (30-90m), (c) ben opens scoped PR to revert condition (1-2h), (d) after canary validation, rollback fw allowlist and close ticket.

olivia: agree. assign tasks: raj = run allowlist and create FW-CR; liam = monitor warm-pool metrics and validate joins; ben = PR to revert condition scoped to grant ARNs; maria = update SOC ticket and cost approval; olivia = coordinate postmortem and customer comms if any.

raj: FW-CR 5912 applied to staging in 8m for canary. applying to prod in ~12m if staging green.

liam: staging looks good — joins recovered to ~95% after fw exception in staging. applying prod.

maria: cost msg posted to billing-ops channel, pre-approved for up to $3k/day for 48h.

ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/7193 — removes iam condition for keystore grants for grant IDs [gr-12345,gr-12346] and adds a test. requesting sec review.

sophie: sec review acked for scoped PR. tagging for 1hr hold for checks.

olivia: after sec ack and merge, we'll remove FW-CR allowlist. timeline looks like ~3h end-to-end. update if drift. thanks all. :pray:

ops-bot: INC-8382 updated: status=mitigating, mitigation=FW-CR 5912 + PR 7193, est-resolve=+3h.

liam: quick postmortem notes to capture: cause=root cause = `kms:ViaService` condition incompatible with privatelink/proxy path; contributing=cumulative strict default-deny egress + missing canary for warm-pool grant changes; detection=warm-pool join metric drop and KMS 403 spikes; mitigation=temporary fw allowlist + scoped IAM revert; followups=add unit test for grant via privatelink, add rollout gating for keystore grant changes, add automated canary for warm-pool join metric.

olivia: thanks. I'll draft the postmortem and assign followups. closing thread when PR merged and fw rule removed.
